description.value:
Up to four motes of light spring into being within range and hover there for the duration, or you may merge them into a single vaguely humanoid glow of Medium size. Each mote (or the combined form) sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

As a bonus action, you can shift the lights up to 60 feet to a new location within range; each mote must stay within 20 feet of another, and any that strays beyond the power's range winks out.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
